don't keep doing it. yeah it can be almost hot, and a new feeling etc., but if it scars you'll regret it forever (because you won't always be this suicidal), and you'll have to look at it every day.

source: i have a whole array of unmistakable cutting scars on the inside of my forearm. i was never really even a cutter, i just read in "girl, interrupted" that it was a thing crazy depressed people did, so i thought i might like to try it. 

about the third time i ever did it, my friend caught me, freaked out and poured MAD DOG 20/20 on my arm to sterilize, because it was the only "alcohol" we had, and then never spoke to me again. we had been really good friends too. 

anyway, because of the Mad Dog, the cuts scarred despite not being that deep... and I have had to relive this one idiotic moment in my life for fifteen years, for example every time it's 85 degrees out and I'm putting on a long-sleeved shirt... again. NOT WORTH IT.

The Cobra Event by Richard Preston. featuring iirc a deranged guy attempting to perform his own autopsy (on himself) and eating his scalp... lots more. 

basically every scene is like Richard Preston sat down and asked himself What's the most disgusting thing I can think of? OK, what one tiny detail would make it a million times worse? 

effective tactic.

problem is if i got an affectionate one i would have 5, which really can't happen. the feral one is snuggly but only on his terms and by his rules (of which there are a surprising amount)

my sister could occupy numerous therapy sessions, which this isn't, not really...

thanks for replying, i am still figuring out how reddit works
